title: News Words: Enigma
source: VOA Learning English (미국 정부 제작물 - 퍼블릭 도메인). 원문: https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/7988030.html

sentences.text: Welcome to the Voice of America's Newswords.
A rare pudu was recently born in an Argentinian zoo, enigma.
Pudus are one of the smallest species of deer in the world.
They are difficult to see and hard to catch in the wild.
Scientists see the pudu as an enigma and this birth as a chance
to study and collect data to protect the species.
An enigma is something hard to understand or explain.
It comes from the Greek language and is similar in meaning to the word mystery.
